[SWS_ANM_00066]
⌈
Each logical NmNetworkHandle shall be mapped to
partial networks(via PncMappingIdent) and/or VLANs (via EthernetCommuni-
cationConnector). Configurations where a logical NmNetworkHandle maps the
same VLAN directly and via partial network(s) shall not be possible.
⌋
